   checks.

   `fig.savefig`/`plt.savefig`; 2,202 of 3,627 committed `.meta.json`
   sidecars (61%) carry no `text` block.

4. **Cause (b) of the #2254 miss - GRAMMAR GAP in check 28.** The four
   slugs the provenance cites - `a0`, `pre@context`, `ctxext@context`,
   `rb@answer` - match NONE of check 28's seven token classes:
   `@L<digits>` requires a digit-bearing layer pin (`@context` /
   `@answer` do not match); the snake-slug class requires >=3 segments or
   a digit-bearing token (these carry no underscore); `H3` / `P1` / `M4`
   / `P3b` are uppercase-initial single-digit codes (`a0` is lowercase);
   `f16`/`l16` is a fixed two-letter prefix; the arm-slug class requires
   >=3 hyphen segments with a digit-bearing tail. So even WITH a `text`
   block, check 28 would not have flagged `per_question_dots.png`.
